content:
设  
\[
P(x,y)=3\ln(1+y)+5x^2,\qquad Q(x,y)=\frac{3x}{1+y}-2y.
\]

因为  
\[
\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=\frac{3}{1+y},\qquad 
\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=\frac{3}{1+y},
\]
所以该线积分与路径无关，可找势函数 \(F(x,y)\) 使得  
\[
dF=P\,dx+Q\,dy.
\]

由  
\[
F_x=3\ln(1+y)+5x^2
\]
得  
\[
F(x,y)=3x\ln(1+y)+\frac{5}{3}x^3+g(y).
\]

再令  
\[
F_y=\frac{3x}{1+y}+g'(y)=\frac{3x}{1+y}-2y,
\]
得  
\[
g'(y)=-2y\Rightarrow g(y)=-y^2.
\]

因此可取  
\[
F(x,y)=3x\ln(1+y)+\frac{5}{3}x^3-y^2.
\]

于是积分值为  
\[
F(B)-F(A).
\]

其中  
\[
A=(1,1),\qquad B=(4,2).
\]

计算：
\[
F(1,1)=3\ln 2+\frac{5}{3}-1=3\ln 2+\frac{2}{3},
\]
\[
F(4,2)=12\ln 3+\frac{5}{3}\cdot 64-4
=12\ln 3+\frac{320}{3}-\frac{12}{3}
=12\ln 3+\frac{308}{3}.
\]

所以  
\[
F(B)-F(A)
=12\ln 3-3\ln 2+\frac{308}{3}-\frac{2}{3}
=3\ln\left(\frac{81}{2}\right)+102.
\]

答案为  
\[
102+3\ln\left(\frac{81}{2}\right).
\]

答案：C
